title: Machine learning in risk prediction of continuous renal replacement therapy after coronary artery bypass grafting surgery in patients.
summary: Full Springer PDF: 190 CABG patients, 72 required CRRT; seven models with 90/10 random split and 10-fold cross-validation. Gaussian Naive Bayes selected for highest AUC; top predictors included troponin T, CK-MB, albumin, LDL, NYHA, creatinine and age. Single-center internal model only. The admission is restricted to this measured result and study setting; it is not evidence of deployment benefit.
